items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I played on the two-day, five or seven, so Jake Grappin' and two-day and Fibon. I played there about two years.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was playing Wood and Joy,

I played on the two-day, five or seven, so Jake Grappin' and two-day and Fibon. I played there about two years. Mm-hmm. We were in the United States. Yeah, but I mean, you weren't with any street band steady, any brass band steady then? Oh yeah, I was playing with the band.
And the old Tuxedo band, the Rikker, the Rikker friends, the old Tuxedo band. Oh yeah.
